note: Invented conversations only: no real guest, phone or email. `turns` are what the guest sends in order. `facts` are the ground truth after the last turn. `expectHandoff` says whether staff should have the thread. `replyLanguage`: en or zh (the bot writes zh back to a Chinese guest and English otherwise).

scenarios.note: Everything given in one message.
turns: Hi, I'm Ana. 2 guests, 1 deluxe room, 2027-02-12 to 2027-02-14, full board, no transfer, no diving.

turns: Hi, this is Ivy. We stayed last week and the room was dirty and nobody at the desk helped us. I am really upset.

turns: Hi, I need to cancel my booking for next month, name is Jack.

turns: Hello, I want a refund of my deposit please. Name Kim.

turns: Hi. Can I talk to a real person please?
